incident.short_description: CrowdStrike detection on FIN-WKS-210 during authorized red-team RT-2025-041
incident.description: CrowdStrike/Defender flagged Cobalt Strike beacon activity on FIN-WKS-210 (David Kim) during approved penetration-test engagement RT-2025-041 (see security exception SEC0000984). Verified authorized; no containment performed. Resolved as authorized/expected activity.
incident.close_notes: Confirmed authorized red-team engagement RT-2025-041 (approved security exception SEC0000984, vendor Redpoint Offensive Security). Activity expected; no containment, account disable, device wipe, or IOC block performed. Applied the standard authorized-testing disposition runbook end to end: closed the CrowdStrike detection and tagged it with the engagement code carried on the IOC allowlist (tag RT-2025-041); triaged the Microsoft Defender alert to classification informationalExpectedActivity / determination securityTesting and set status resolved; ran a proportionate Intune windowsDefenderScan only (no wipe/retire); added the affected user to the 'Authorized Security Testing' group in Okta and in Google Workspace; added the host to the CrowdStrike 'Authorized Security Testing' host group; set the Snipe-IT asset status label to 'Deployed - Security Reviewed' and recorded an asset audit; acknowledged the matching security exception against this incident (u_acknowledged_incident=INC0018010, u_ack_state=acknowledged); marked the Google Alert Center feedback NOT_USEFUL; assigned to and closed by the Security Operations analyst (Dana Cross).
